message: `deriving` parsed and derived nothing, and is now refused
label: `deriving` was refused rather than implemented: the clause parsed and was silently discarded - no instance was ever derived from it, and a clause that does nothing is worse than one that does not parse
help: derive instances explicitly, where you want them: `(deriveEq T)` is an ordinary declaration macro (docs/macro-system.md MAC-CAP-9)
